_comment: Two-target overtaking scenario for the tracker stress test (Approach 2, same-direction overtaking). Both targets have positive velocity, but Target A is faster and starts behind Target B in range. They meet at range = 4 m around frame ~40 (at 20 Hz frame rate). Their velocities differ by only 0.5 m/s -- under one Doppler bin -- so at the crossing both targets are in the SAME range bin AND in adjacent (or merged) Doppler bins, leaving the tracker no clean way to separate them by either dimension. This is the textbook hard data-association test: even GNN should struggle to maintain stable IDs through this crossing. Amplitudes are well above the CFAR detection threshold so detection itself is not the failure mode.
